answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a physical proof-of-work, such as a unique, computationally expensive 3D model of a basalt formation. Each agent must solve a complex geometric problem to generate a model, similar to tracking the trajectory of a comet through space. The model serves as a digital identity, verified by peers through a trellis-based validation protocol, making it costly for an attacker to create multiple fake identities, thereby providing Sybil resistance.
